## About
Painter's Grinding was started by Dayton Painter, who began with Volkswagen engine work like lifter repair and cylinder head reconditioning out of a small shop behind his friend's shop. Members of his family run the business today.
The shop has grown into a full range of services, including repair, engine rebuilding and machine work for air-cooled Volkswagen engines. We keep rebuilt transaxles in stock for exchange, and we work on water-cooled VWs too.
The crew here grew up around these cars. Ross Maitland is a mechanic and machinist, Eddie Radillo builds transmissions, and Keith Gosselin is an engine builder and mechanic. Owners have given us a 4.8 rating from 168 Google reviews.

## Services
- Machine Shop Services: A full range of machine work, including precision work on cases, flywheels and cranks.
- Engine & Transmission Rebuilding: Engine and transmission rebuilds for air-cooled VW owners.
- General Repair & Services: Brakes, oil changes, engine and transmission removal and replacement, and a variety of other mechanical repairs.
- Parts: One reviewer called us a good place to buy parts.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on water-cooled VWs?
A: Yes. Air-cooled engines are our roots, but we work on both air-cooled and water-cooled VWs.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: We close Saturdays for the winter season, and regular Saturday hours pick back up in April. If you need help outside our regular schedule, give us a call.

Q: I have a question about a parts order. What should I include?
A: Email us with your name, phone number, order number and the date you bought your parts, and a customer service representative will contact you.

Q: What is the difference between air-cooled and water-cooled?
A: Air-cooled engines move heat straight to the air through fins on the cylinders and heads. Water-cooled engines circulate coolant around the heads and cylinders through a water jacket and use a radiator to pass the heat to the air.
